meta.name: define-icp
meta.description: Define Ideal Customer Profile with firmographic, technographic, and behavioral criteria plus scoring tiers. Use when user asks about "ICP", "ideal customer profile", "who to target", "scoring criteria", "tier system", "firmographic", "technographic", "buyer persona". Do NOT use for finding specific companies (use source-companies) or contact search (use find-contacts).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定义理想客户画像，包含公司、技术和行为标准及评分层级。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要精准定义目标客户以优化营销策略。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to precisely define your target customers to optimize marketing strategies.

howto.what: 装好后，当你要求定义理想客户画像时，Claude 会输出包含公司画像、技术画像和行为信号的三层画像，并基于100分打分系统划分客户等级。如有 ColdIQ 连接，会先验证数据。
howto.when: 当你提到“ICP”、“理想客户画像”、“目标客户”、“打分标准”等关键词，或询问如何定义客户画像时触发。

say.text: 帮我定义一个理想客户画像，针对中型企业。
say.note: Claude 会要求补充行业、规模等条件，然后给出完整画像。

say.text: 设定一个ICP打分系统，权重包括行业匹配度和公司规模。
say.note: Claude 会生成打分矩阵，并划分Tier A-D等级。

say.text: 根据我现有的客户反向推导ICP。
say.note: Claude 会引导你分析已有成交客户的特征来定义画像。

howto.what_en: When asked to define an ideal customer profile, Claude outputs a structured ICP with firmographic, technographic, and behavioral layers, plus a 100-point scoring system that assigns tier A-D. If ColdIQ is connected, it first validates criteria against live data.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user mentions 'ICP', 'ideal customer profile', 'who to target', 'scoring criteria', 'tier system', or similar terms. Not for finding specific companies or contacts.

say_en.text: Define an ideal customer profile for mid-market companies.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for details then output a full ICP.

say_en.text: Create a scoring system with weights for industry and company size.
say_en.note: Claude generates a scoring matrix and tier assignment.

say_en.text: Reverse-engineer an ICP from my existing customers.
say_en.note: Claude guides you to analyze closed-won deals to derive the ICP.
